Comment: shot-metadata-enrichment: shots.json -> image-bounded window plan -> Map-rendered image records (checkpointed, OOM-bounded batches) -> ONE waitForTaskToken submit to bedrock-inference (no polling) -> coverage + pairing repair + scene assembly. conversation-analysis's five-state template with the render step widened to a Map + a stage state (user decision 2026-08-19: Map + small thread pool; per-window side-object checkpoints make LambdaResourceTimeoutException retries resume, not restart). Readability copy of the template's inline DefinitionString; edit BOTH, the build fails on drift.

Validate and plan.Comment: Everything that can refuse refuses HERE, before any inference dollar: shots.json fetch+validate, the optional face/transcript joins, get_prompt (binds `default`, checks the 7-token values catalog), IMAGE-capable model-chain validation against bedrock's registry, the image-bounded window plan (10-shot target inside the 20-image budget incl. gallery), Map batches, history scope. Persists _plan/plan.json; states pass URIs, never bodies.

Render windows.Comment: One iteration per window batch (WINDOWS_PER_BATCH, default 10) — the OOM-bounded unit: each iteration threads RENDER_THREADS (default 3) tarball fetches, renders through the copied prompt_render module, and checkpoints every window as _records/window_NNN.json. LambdaResourceTimeoutException retries RESUME (existing side objects are skipped), they never restart.

Stage records.Comment: Concatenate the per-window checkpoints, in window order, into records.jsonl — STREAMED via S3 multipart (an image record is MBs; a long asset's set is never held whole). Refuses on a missing window checkpoint and on an image over-budget (defence in depth beside bedrock's own max_images guard).

Submit and wait.Comment: The template's §8 shape verbatim: ONE held state, NO polling. The handler invokes bedrock-inference's gateway Lambda inline (records_s3uri + callback_task_token + idempotency_token = THIS run's uuid) and writes the history pointer from the TRUE submit response. bedrock's waker completes the token with the terminal status as DATA. NO Catch: a timeout FAILS the execution, and a REDRIVE of this state resubmits, absorbs, and is completed synchronously — redrive IS the reconcile. use_batch defaults TRUE here (plan.json carries the explicit bool).

Collect and finalize.Comment: ONE state for both halves: parse the per-window JSONL (fence-tolerant, nothing more), validate coverage per shot_id, apply the §4 pairing repair (`false` wins in BOTH directions, repairs COUNTED — the rate is an interleaved-genre detector), assemble scenes from the repaired flags, write shots + scenes + window-manifest. Unanswered shot_ids land in shots_gap HONESTLY — partial success is success; the rerun is the caller's fresh idempotency_token. A terminally FAILED bedrock run raises and propagates as itself.

Usage tracking.Comment: Aggregates the run's summary/usage documents into the usage label. Success path only; the handler never raises — as the terminal state, an exception here would fail an execution whose products are already written.
